title: Dual of a finite constant module sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative noetherian ring. Let $M$ be a finitely generated $\Lambda$-module. Write $M_X$ for its constant coefficient sheaf on the small étale site of $X$ [def-constructible-constant], and $\Lambda_X$ for the monoidal unit. Then $\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(M_X,\Lambda_X)\cong (\operatorname{Hom}_\Lambda(M,\Lambda))_X$ as sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules.

proof.text: Use Mathlib's Module.finitePresentation_of_finite and Module.FinitePresentation.exists_fin' to choose finite ranks n,m and maps f: Lambda^n -> M and g: Lambda^m -> Lambda^n, with f surjective and ker f = range g. This is two Lean lines and does not construct data from an unproved theorem.

Mathlib's ModuleCat.isColimitCokernelCofork applied to the exact presentation and surjectivity of f makes f a categorical cokernel of g. Compare this cocone to the chosen categorical cokernel using cokernelIsCokernel.coconePointUniqueUpToIso, obtaining cokernel(g) isomorphic to M. Apply the constant sheaf functor and PreservesCokernel.iso to identify M_X with the cokernel of the constant matrix.

Let D be MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj of the sheaf unit. This functor preserves limits by the braided tensor-Hom adjunction in Mathlib. Construct eD by mapping the opposite cokernel comparison through D, mapping the inverse of kernelOpOp, and applying PreservesKernel.iso. Apply the independent finite-matrix kernel comparison eF, then compose eD, eF and C.mapIso eA.symm. No downstream constant-dual theorem is imported.

Mathlib identifies range f.dualMap with (ker f).dualAnnihilator and ker g.dualMap with (range g).dualAnnihilator. Since ker f = range g, these submodules agree. Surjectivity of f makes f.dualMap injective, so LinearEquiv.ofInjective followed by LinearEquiv.ofEq gives Hom(M,Lambda) isomorphic to ker g.dualMap. Apply constant sheafification to its inverse and compose with the preceding two isomorphisms.

theorem nonempty_constantModuleDualIso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Module.Finite Λ M] :
    Nonempty ((ihom ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj
      (𝟙_ _) ≅ (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of Λ (M →ₗ[Λ] Λ)))
